content.title: Zillow’s (NASDAQ:ZG) Q3: Beats On Revenue
content.summary: Online real estate marketplace Zillow (NASDAQ:ZG) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 16.4% year on year to $676 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $650 million at the midpoint, 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.04 per share was $0.01 above analysts’ consensus estimates.
